title: anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh
why_read: A static image reference gallery for AI-generated character poses, useful mainly as an artist's reference tool rather than a technical project.
analysis: This is a Chinese-language gallery of pose reference images intended to help artists or AI image generation users pick poses, built as a dependency-free static site. It is a content curation project rather than a novel piece of engineering, so there is little technical substance for a software engineering audience. The dependency-free, zero-build approach is mildly notable as a simple implementation choice but not something most engineers would need to read about.
